name: Stingray Group Inc.
summary: Stingray Group Inc. is a company in music, media and technology serving Canada, the United States and international markets through Broadcasting and Commercial Music and Radio segments. For brands it provides music, advertising and digital services, covering radio stations, audio and video channels, on-demand video, ad-supported TV channels, karaoke products, music apps and in-car infotainment, as well as in-store music and digital signage.
